sqlReaderQuery.value:
select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.SEC_Date=dd.sec_previous_business_day and dd.sec_business_day_flag='Y'

activities.name: Iterate Execution of Process Date Range

DECLARE @SEC_PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @SEC_PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = SEC_PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_SEC_TBLCLIENT]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @SEC_PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_SEC_TBLCLIENT_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.CLTCODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CLTCODE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
